name: Landhof Danler
beschreibung: Landhof Danler welcomes holidaymakers to a sunny and quiet setting in Neustift in the Stubai Valley, framed by the impressive summits of the Stubai glacier world. This family-operated guesthouse offers authentic Tyrolean warmth and cozy accommodations. Comfortably appointed rooms and apartments feature private balconies with unobstructed views of surrounding three-thousand-meter peaks. A garden lawn with sun loungers and a children's play area provides outdoor relaxation. Free ski buses connect swiftly to the Elfer lifts, Schlick 2000, and the year-round Stubai Glacier, while summer hiking trails depart from the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run country farm guesthouse in Neustift in the Stubai Valley featuring glacier views and gardens.
